column1: # RYDE v2.1.0 (specification 23/09/2025), the official submission package from
# https://pqc-ryde.org/resources.html (zip; sha256 pinned in .source, checked by the
# Makefile). There is no public upstream git repository. Optimized_Implementation/
# (one directory per parameter set) built as upstream's README says
# (cmake -DOPT_IMPL=avx: AVX2 + AES-NI + PCLMUL, XKCP AVX2 Keccak, -D_SHAKE_TIMES4_),
# with the default Rijndael-based commitments: the variant of the spec's first
# performance table, whose cycle counts the YAML carries. Sizes match each set's
# src/parameters.h and data/schemes/RYDE.yaml; our build reproduces the shipped
# Columns: file, name, pk, sk, sig, iters, dir (Optimized_Implementation/<dir>),
